candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from /v1/reservations and 502 up through order and gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs absent; timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) in inventory, cascading to 503 reservations and 502 checkout/orders; gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2406ms) and 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics (latency, connections, saturation) for inventory's redis dependency
Inventory service logs/metrics confirming redis timeout as the failing dependency
